scope: S4 engineering food field and bilateral receptor transduction only; S5 integration delegated to parent; no walking evidence or parent tracker changes
model: C=A*smoothstep(clip((t-onset)/rise,0,1))*exp(-||xy-center||^2/(2*sigma^2)); patch_radius is food contact geometry metadata and does not flatten Gaussian
receptor: u=C/(K+C); r_next=r+(u-r)*(-expm1(-dt/tau)); zero initial state; tau default 0.05 seconds; dt default 0.005 seconds
causality: time_s is interval START; current position and concentration held over [time_s,time_s+dt_s); returned pair is endpoint response. Subsequent intervals must be contiguous; no future sampling. Smooth onset default rise_s=0.2 seconds.
pose: head local +x forward, +y left; local engineering offsets transformed by head rotation; no anatomical calibration claimed
actor_boundary: sample returns only float64 array shape (2,) ordered left,right; source configuration/time/position remain environment-side; no steering
noise: optional independent additive Gaussian receptor-output noise, explicitly seeded, clipped to [0,1], does not contaminate latent exact receptor state
acceptance: analytic exact exponential response and constant-stimulus timestep composition within 1e-14
immutable source and malformed inputs rejected
rejected sample leaves state and RNG untouched
limits: NumPy and Python standard library only; no installs, training, anatomy claims, behavior acceptance or SI calibration
